name: Трансформация Безработного
tagline: A Russian-language party quiz about our friend Phil, with mini-games, a live feed, a Divine Orb price tracker and an invite-only portal builder.
description: A Russian-language party site built around our friend Phil (aka x23x): a 10-question quiz with a shared leaderboard, achievements and hidden easter eggs. Players can submit facts about Phil, and Root AI - model b1t quiz v1.1 turns them into new funny questions. A 3D cartoon Phil walks around the page, comments on everything and levels up a shared talent tree, next to basketball and other mini-games and a Path of Exile Divine Orb price exchange. Invited members can also build a similar portal about themselves or a friend with Root AI - model b1t portal v1.0.
